I hate to be "that guy", but as someone who hasn't closely followed the "vape scene", I have no idea what you're holding. It's obviously a mod, I'm going to assume it's regulated, and it's obviously an RDA and it's probably low ohms, and that juice is probably $.75/ml.. but that's all I got.

So, speaking for those of us who don't have the time and/or patience to watch every review on YouTube and read every group-buy thread on ECF, what exactly are we looking at?

You aren't "that guy", I promise. It's really easy (and intimidating) to keep up with every new thing in the world of vaping. What you're looking at specifically is a regulated high-end box mod. It's called The Box APV by Limelight Mechanics. "High end box mod" is a term which means it's fairly expensive, and only a certain number are made. Sitting on top of The Box APV is a Hellboy RDA, but it isn't that low of a build. It's a single coil 1.2ohm build because I'm all about chasing the flavor. The juice is by a company which many are realizing is one of the best, and it's called ANML. They have two flavors out right now, Carnage (strawberry candy) and Looper (sweet cereal milk). $.75/ml is about an accurate representation.

If you have any other questions, I'm happy to answer them. No such thing as a dumb question here, just a new opportunity to learn a little bit more!
